name: web-sandbox
description: Local-first sandbox for untrusted web content: opaque-origin iframe, immutable CSP, no backend.

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.build:lib: rm -rf dist && bun scripts/build-lib.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun scripts/declaration-specifiers.ts && bun scripts/declaration-base.ts
scripts.api:check: bun run build:lib && api-extractor run && bun scripts/api-model.ts check
scripts.api:update: bun run build:lib && api-extractor run --local && bun scripts/api-model.ts update
